report_title: Health Security Failure Injection & Resilience Report

scenarios.name: Health Payload Secret Injection
scenarios.attack_vector: Injected simulated DB password into /health diagnostic response
scenarios.expected_defense: Response interceptor strips connection URI and replaces with sanitized status
scenarios.actual_outcome: Interceptor replaced raw URI with {'db_status': 'UP', 'sanitized': True}

scenarios.name: Log Stream PII Injection
scenarios.attack_vector: Injected raw customer CNIC and email into error logging pipeline
scenarios.expected_defense: Logger redaction pipeline masks CNIC and email automatically
scenarios.actual_outcome: Log output formatted as: 'User [REDACTED_CNIC] ([REDACTED_EMAIL]) caused OCR timeout'

scenarios.name: Unauthorized Diagnostic Probe
scenarios.attack_vector: Sent unauthenticated probe to /diagnostics with forged bearer header
scenarios.expected_defense: API Gateway / Auth middleware returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized immediately
scenarios.actual_outcome: Gateway returned HTTP 401 with 'Invalid or malformed signature' message

scenarios.name: High-Cardinality Metric Label Flooding Attack
scenarios.attack_vector: Attempted to push 100,000 unique metric labels per second into Prometheus collector
scenarios.expected_defense: Telemetry cardinality filter drops ephemeral UUID label and rolls up to route template
scenarios.actual_outcome: Telemetry filter clamped cardinality; ephemeral UUID dropped, route rolled up to '/api/v1/documents/{id}'
